newsitem.title: UK: European cotton sees modest inquiry.
newsitem.headline: European cotton sees modest inquiry.

text.p: Traders mostly found it hard to generate new business in main European raw cotton markets as buyers seemed to want cotton for shipment in the late summer months,when the trade is best served in respect of supply.
Some competitive offers remained in circulation of Central Asian descriptions nearby and fresh sales have been concluded in Portugal and Italy. Some inquiry was noted from France.

West African attracted continued attention with some offers remaining attractive. Mills wanting later shipment supplies have turned to growths less frequently traded in Europea. There has also been some price testing inquiry for American descriptions.
